logical_gates.implementation_detail: The authenticated runner remains a separately launched operator workflow; no managed run entry point owns the complete campaign.

logical_gates.name: Authenticated synthetic/public model campaign

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Provider-free lineage and authority mechanisms exist, but externally anchored REAL qualification and runtime authority are not complete.
logical_gates.integrity_property: No model self-qualifies and same-root judging cannot authorize completion.
logical_gates.name: Evidence-sealed model lineage, qualification, and selection

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Benchmark evaluation, certification, and verification remain separate explicit commands.

logical_gates.name: Frozen benchmark and superiority evidence

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Bounded budgets and fail-closed reconciliation are implemented; managed provisioning is tracked separately.
logical_gates.integrity_property: Spend must stop below the frozen ceiling and every provider call must reconcile.
logical_gates.name: Autonomous USD and token ceilings

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Scope is currently supplied through files and command options rather than a purchase-bound client intake record.

logical_gates.name: Purchase-bound audit scope and authorization

logical_gates.implementation_detail: The CLI still accepts per-run acknowledgements and an operator-authored consent file.

logical_gates.name: Purchase-bound privacy, egress, and retention decision

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Database and query-suite paths remain operator-configured inputs.
logical_gates.integrity_property: CodeQL analysis must use the intended database and reviewed query suite or fail closed.
logical_gates.name: Prebuilt CodeQL database and query suite

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Ledger enforcement exists, but initialization and selection are separate operator actions.

logical_gates.name: Existing cumulative cost ledger

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Snapshot verification exists, while snapshot creation and selection remain external.

logical_gates.name: Reviewed dependency snapshot

logical_gates.implementation_detail: No externally published transparency receipt or inclusion/consistency proof can currently authorize runtime completion.

logical_gates.name: Externally anchored append-only authority seal

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Forensic export and verification still require a per-command acknowledgement.

logical_gates.name: Sensitive forensic evidence delivery consent

logical_gates.implementation_detail: The endpoint, chain, block, and acknowledgement remain per-run/operator inputs.

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Typed formal controls exist, but managed engines and all required execution evidence are not provisioned end to end.
logical_gates.integrity_property: Every required formal engine and check must run or create an explicit incomplete result.
logical_gates.name: Required formal-engine execution

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Many fail-closed floors exist, but the managed profile and all REAL prerequisites do not.

logical_gates.implementation_detail: The frozen objective explicitly replaces signer authority and excludes human sign-off.
logical_gates.integrity_property: Human approval cannot become a completion prerequisite.
logical_gates.name: Human signature and sign-off boundary

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Typed harness validation exists, but a reviewed versioned template library and derivation proof do not.

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Objective-required commands remain separate and no zero-input managed orchestration path exists.
logical_gates.integrity_property: One managed workflow must own campaign, audit, benchmark, seal, validation, and release.
logical_gates.name: Zero-operator completion workflow

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Output parents and any resume state are still supplied externally for each command.

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Configuration provenance is strict, but no immutable managed profile bundles every input.

logical_gates.implementation_detail: A typed nonauthorizing catalog and config projection bind 28 first-class managed roles, but fixed operating-system probe helpers remain unmodeled and lack exact identity verification. logical_gates.implementation_detail: Private-repository auditing is explicitly opt-in and outside completion.
logical_gates.integrity_property: Private source must not be required or silently egressed for objective completion.
logical_gates.name: Private-repository completion boundary

logical_gates.implementation_detail: The safe secrets-env-file transport exists, but each external launch still supplies it.
logical_gates.integrity_property: Provider credentials must be pre-supplied without entering artifacts or inventory reads.

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Verification, certification, export, and release observations remain separate commands.
logical_gates.integrity_property: Release must bind complete verified evidence with no human sign-off.
logical_gates.name: Evidence-sealed validation and release

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Typed report and manifest completeness gates exist; managed orchestration is separate.
logical_gates.integrity_property: A managed run must publish every required bounded deliverable or remain incomplete.
logical_gates.name: Required client and machine-readable reports

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Capability validation is implemented, while deployment-specific allowlists remain authored in each configuration.
logical_gates.integrity_property: Dynamic validation may use only declared, bounded, local defensive capabilities.
logical_gates.name: Bounded reproduction capability policy

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Targets are literal configuration values; no complete deterministic derivation exists.

logical_gates.name: Deterministic reproduction targets

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Phase 0 binds the complete source-package payload, but the installed distribution is not yet independently measured and enforced by a managed run.

logical_gates.name: SaaS and liability claim boundary

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Fail-closed secret detection and explicit raw-storage controls are implemented.

logical_gates.name: Secret detection, redaction, and raw-storage policy

logical_gates.implementation_detail: Snapshot import still requires an explicit per-command acknowledgement.
